milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Target is the redstone torch at [-5, 2, 3] (top of left structure, most visible). Player must navigate within 16 blocks and face toward it, confirming visual identification.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Target is the center of the iron bars front wall at [4, 1, 5]. Player must navigate within 16 blocks and face toward the bars, confirming visual identification of the cage.
Uses inventory_has because mining a trapped chest drops it as an item into the player's inventory. This directly confirms the block was successfully broken.
